items.title: From flood-hit areas to crime scenes, Nepal’s police dogs sniff out vital clues
items.blurb: One of 107 dogs in the police force, Leo located two bodies and human remains during a 20-day search after the Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: A pontoon bridge unused for 13 years finds a new home in Dhading
items.blurb: The bridge, which once connected Rajapur with other parts of Bardiya, is being refurbished to restore transport links between Gajuri and Siddhalek after floods swept away the concrete bridge.

items.title: Pokhara Avengers’ losing streak continues in NPL
items.blurb: Chitwan Rhinos hand Avengers fourth straight defeat, leaving them bottom of the table without a point after three matches.

items.title: Chitwan beat Pokhara by 30 runs to move into third position in the NPL
items.blurb: Sikandar Raza and Ravi Bopara added 60 for the fifth wicket before Rijan Dhakal and Kamal Singh Airee shared seven wickets to leave Pokhara facing a fourth straight defeat.
